statement_pin_required.convention: Fix finite PartialOrder α. Chain/antichain = Mathlib IsChain/IsAntichain on Finsets. Claim: there is a chain partition of univ of size width (= max antichain card). Easy inequality width ≤ partition size is Level A. König reduction uses SimpleGraph on α ⊕ α with Adj (inl a) (inr b) ↔ a < b (strict), then konig_bipartite.
landmines: Finite only (Fintype α). Infinite Dilworth is out of scope.
Not König (do not re-prime konig-bipartite A/B). Not Hall. Not Mirsky (dual).
Split graph uses strict <, not ≤ (SimpleGraph Adj is irreflexive).
Do NOT apply König to the comparability graph (not bipartite in general).
Do not cite konig_bipartite or hall_hard_inductive as Dilworth.
Empty poset width 0; chain poset width 1; antichain poset width = card.
No Greene / Greene–Kleitman extension in v1.
statement_pin_required.canonical_source: R. P. Dilworth, A decomposition theorem for partially ordered sets, Ann. of Math. 51 (1950) 161–166. Matching pin: Fulkerson, Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 7 (1956) 701–702. Type pin: Mathlib IsChain / IsAntichain + ProofLab.Konig.konig_bipartite.
